templates.pat: medRxiv aims to provide a venue for anyone to comment on a medRxiv preprint. Comments are moderated for offensive or irrelevant content (this can take ~24 h). Please avoid duplicate submissions. The content of a comment is not endorsed by medRxiv. medRxiv is now using a new commenting interface powered by Hypothes.is. All comments previously submitted via the legacy platform (Disqus) have been transferred to the new platform using the medRxiv_admin account. Please read our {{1}} for more information.
templates.zh: medRxiv 旨在为任何人提供评论 medRxiv 预印本的场所。评论会针对攻击性或无关内容进行审核（可能需要约 24 小时）。请勿重复提交。评论内容不代表 medRxiv 的认可。medRxiv 现已改用由 Hypothes.is 提供支持的新评论界面。此前通过旧平台（Disqus）提交的所有评论均已使用 medRxiv_admin 账号迁移至新平台。更多信息请阅读我们的 {{1}}。
